description: Answer an open 1-question survey and receive its payout. Each account can answer a survey once. Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

answer_1.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

name: geode_surveys_take_a_survey_1
title: Surveys: take a survey 1
